subject: Request: one-off pilot accelerant exception (credits + 30d extension)
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@havenhealth.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-05-14T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot needs — additional runway and credit allowance

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for a great kickoff last week. Our engineers have been pushing a heavier throughput profile through the sandbox than we initially estimated; we’re seeing realistic end-to-end latency and stability but we’re burning through the included PLG credits much faster than the UI anticipated.

Quick facts: this is for a clinician-facing summarization flow (redacted PHI-free test data) — traffic spiked after we added multi-patient batching to emulate production. We’re ~80% of the way through the free quota in 9 days (vs. expected 21 days).

Ask: would Redwood consider a one-off supplement of 150,000 token credits and a 30-day pilot window extension while we complete an additional integration and compliance signoff? This extension would enable us to finish an internal evaluation and firm up procurement for a Dedicated commitment.

We’ve attached a usage snapshot and a short note from our PM. Happy to jump on a call if that helps.

Best,
Samantha
Product Lead — HavenHealth

Attachments:
- HavenHealth_POC_SLA_Request.pdf (pdf)
- HavenHealth_Usage_Snapshot.csv (csv)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: samantha.cole@havenhealth.ai
Date: 2025-05-15T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot needs — additional runway and credit allowance

Team — forwarding HavenHealth's request. Short ask from Samantha: 150k token supplement + 30-day extension. They’re close to an enterprise pilot and this is the gating item before procurement signs a PO for Dedicated capacity.

Why I’m escalating: HavenHealth is a high-probability midmarket deal (clinical workflows, regulated buyer) and a relatively small one-off ask could materially increase our chance of conversion to a paid committed deployment. They’ve already run stress tests that prove model choices and latency targets.

Proposal I’d support: grant 75k tokens today and approve an additional 75k contingent on short integration acceptance criteria (we get the post-integration usage report + MOU signed). Roll the extension only upon receipt of the signed MOU.

Can we get quick signoff or objections? If Jonas/Aditya prefer, we can align with Deal Desk to put the contingent portion on a narrow SLA.

Thanks,
Grace
Sr. AM, Redwood Inference

3) Controls: I like the contingent split — 75k upfront, 75k contingent on MOU + integration acceptance. Add expiry on the extension (30 days from grant) and require procurement contact to confirm intent to submit PO within that window.
